title: Nemotron Bolt - sirf 4GB mein AI agent
content:
Ek AI agent jo sirf chaar GB memory mein chal sakta hai.
Cloud nahi, aapki apni machine pe.
NVIDIA ne kal ek naya open small model release kiya. Naam hai Nemotron three point five Bolt E4B.
It is built on Google's Gemma 4 E4B, with NVIDIA's own post-training on top.
Iska focus ek hi cheez pe hai. Conversational agents, jo baat bhi karein aur kaam bhi karein.
NVIDIA ke numbers dekhiye.
Apne pichle model ke comparison mein, key conversational agent benchmarks pe around forty percent higher average quality.
Aur peers ke comparison mein up to eighty percent kam tokens output karta hai.
Kam tokens ka matlab, faster replies. Especially voice mein, jahan har second matter karta hai.
Remember, these are NVIDIA's own benchmark claims.
Ab sawaal ye hai, ye actually kar kya sakta hai?
Pehla, multi-turn tool use. Matlab baat-cheet ke beech mein ye aapki app ke APIs call kar sakta hai.
Doosra, conversational mode. Isse replies chhote aur bolne layak aate hain.
Teesra, reasoning on ya off kar sakte ho. Mushkil sawaal pe sochega, simple sawaal pe turant jawab dega.
It also has a sixty four thousand token context and supports thirty five languages.
NVIDIA ke hisaab se ye GeForce RTX, Jetson, RTX Spark aur DGX Spark pe chalne ke liye bana hai.
Toh aap ise use kaise kar sakte ho?
Maan lo aap ek clinic ke liye reception assistant bana rahe ho.
Patient puchhta hai, kal ka appointment khali hai kya?
Model aapke booking API ko call karega, slot check karega, aur chhota sa bolne layak jawab dega.
And because it runs locally, patient data does not have to leave the clinic's machine.
Start small. Ek kaam chuno, do ya teen tools do, aur dekho kahan fail hota hai.
Mera take simple hai.
Har AI app ko giant cloud model ki zaroorat nahi hai.
Small local models privacy, speed aur cost, teeno mein jeet sakte hain. Ye skill seekhne layak hai.
